parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom supporting structure of the cabinet, made of plywood for stability and strength.
parts.Functional_description: It provides foundational support for the entire cabinet, ensuring balance and weight distribution.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the door and drawer components.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that supports other moving components.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding wooden compartment located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides accessible storage for smaller items and can be pulled out for use.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails or grooves.
